notes.title: Project UNSEEK is Now Available!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=WmnmYQHZgrI;full][/previewyoutube]
Project UNSEEK is now available on Steam for Windows and Mac! 
Have fun, scream, and laugh together with your friends in a 2v6 class-based asymmetrical online multiplayer horror game inspired by 80s slasher horror movies, SCP urban legend, and Science Fiction, where you compete against each other to survive the experiment as High Schoolers or Mythical Creatures.

You can purchase Project UNSEEK only for the following:

 $4.99
 £3.99
 €3.99
 ¥520
 Rp39,999


Also, you can grab it 10% OFF on the launch period (November 10 - 17, 2023), don’t miss it!

Come and bring your friends to play Project UNSEEK together!

PS: Don’t forget to leave a review after you play! It will help us a lot!

notes.title: Project UNSEEK Release Date Annoucement
notes.content:
Exciting news all!

After almost two years of development, Project UNSEEK finally has a release date, and it will be released on 10 November 2023 (GMT+7)!

[previewyoutube=SHBSX6mViPU;full][/previewyoutube]

What to expect on the full release version of Project UNSEEK?

3 New Playable Characters
In the full release of Project UNSEEK, you will be able to play previously locked characters on the demo: Tech tinker girl J-Li, Faithfully religious boy Christopher, and Creature, inspired by Indonesian urban legend, the thief Boar Demon. More about them will be showcased on our social media, so stay tuned!

2 New Map Variant
In the full-release version of Project UNSEEK, you will able to play at 2 previously locked maps, Deep Middle and Crew Quarter, a variant of Quiet Hills and Testing Lab.

Improved art and animation
We have polished several assets and animations for better enjoyment of the game.

Bug Fix
We try to wipe out a lot of bugs we can find, so hopefully, your gameplay will have fewer hiccups.


We hope you are as excited as we are! Before the release day, you can try the demo with your friends, and if you enjoy your gameplay, please add it to your Steam wishlist and spread your experience with everyone!

notes.title: Project UNSEEK Demo is BACK!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=MatBiW3XDtc;full][/previewyoutube]

Hey there, amazing news! We're thrilled to announce that the demo of Project UNSEEK is now available for the public! That means you can dive into the game, play with your friends, and experience all the fun for FREE before deciding to purchase the full version when it's released. The demo gives you a taste of what the complete Project UNSEEK has to offer, although we've kept some exclusive characters and cosmetics reserved for the full game.
Here are some fantastic updates we've made for the demo:

 Brand New Characters
In this demo, you'll meet the complete roster of characters available in the full game, including three exciting new additions. Meet J-Li, a clever girl with a knack for scrambling the system, Christopher, a man of faith, and Boar Demon, a shape-shifting thief demon with two formidable forms. Three of these characters will be exclusively unlocked in the full version. Stay tuned to our social media channels and blog for more details about them!

 Character Cosmetics: Companions and Trail Effects
Now, you can personalize your characters even further with Companion and Trail effect cosmetics! Using in-game points, you can purchase these delightful additions that will follow your character's every move in the game. Make your presence known with these cool companions and stylish trail effects.

 Enhanced Visuals and Animations
We've gone the extra mile to revamp our visual assets, particularly in the maps, by incorporating more 3D elements than ever before. Additionally, we've improved character animations to bring out their personalities when unleashing their skills. Get ready for a visually stunning and immersive experience!

 UI and UX Enhancements
We believe in continually refining the user interface and experience to create a seamless and intuitive gameplay environment. We've implemented various updates to make navigating the game feel natural and effortless. We want you to have the best gaming experience possible!

 Bug Fixes
We've been hard at work squashing pesky bugs causing headaches for our dedicated team of programmers and testers. Rest assured, the current build of the demo is now considered virtually bug-free. Your gaming sessions should be smoother!


With the release of this demo, we genuinely hope that you and everyone else will have an absolute blast playing Project UNSEEK. After giving the game a go, we'd love to hear your feedback. Your input will help us further improve and refine the game, making it an even more incredible experience.
Get ready to have some serious fun!

notes.title: Q1 2023 Development Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone!
Welcome to our newest development blog of Project UNSEEK.
It’s already the end of March! Q1 of 2023 just ended. It’s time to report some of the developments and updates we have done thus far. Let’s go!


Map update
 We’re testing new layout variations of our maps. Also, all of the maps will have more 3D assets than ever!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/8bad852b4b2419448cb0b97e9204be99dcb3ddaf.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/24f49eb34c47308dbb2b7947707ddd47711f2e35.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/09004ed23a2e0c3b39e74e0b977e52d33efbf1ef.png {STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/76be1e37e9e65fe79f31051984ca91e665420e25.png

UI/UX update
 We’re updating some UI in the main menu and lobby room to create a more streamlined experience.
Main Menu:
- You can now exit the game directly from the main menu.
- Select the server region in the main menu.
Lobby:
- You can now invite Steam friends to join using the in-game button.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/d8912dff9c3e9c9b4c6443770a95fe049ffb824f.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/49d487f30dfea293fd4967272771a09e9e7d804a.png

Steam Integration
 Project UNSEEK is now integrated with Steam. Some of the notable features:
- Stream friends game invite
- Show your in-game status on your Steam profile status.
- Steam Achievement.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/856b62d66d0c31a3dfc83f70111d3db8625331f4.png

New character and basic items
 We’re working on adding more colorful characters that we’ll reveal to you later. Stay tuned!

Character customization
 In case you missed our demo in steam next fest, we’re implementing character customization to personalize your character from hat to trousers.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/2d38bf797d94b5b6f4b0458eac1ceef544035a52.png

Tutorial
 We’re adding a selection of tutorials for new players to learn about the basics of the game. The prompt will appear when you play the game for the first time, or you can access it later using the Journal menu.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/3c79ef2cae923d694138a44a35852f23f4f8b0ca.png

Voice chat
 You can enable voice chat in every session, and the room master can also enable proximity voice chat to add more immersion to the session.

Non-Randomized Mode
 We are working on adding a non-randomized role mode to add more variety to your gameplay.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/2106861956747749be119719a15c6f8dd54c52f2.png

Audio update
 We’re working with talented artists to add voice-over and new background music to add a more immersive experience to the game.

Better controller support implementation in the menu
 Awkward pseudo cursor no more!

Bug fixing and polishing
 As usual, our programmer works hard to fix everything whenever we add new features.

That’s it for the development update. Can’t wait to see our game in action when it is finally released.

But wait, there’s more!
Earlier this week, Some of our team just safely landed back from San Francisco, attending GCA and GDC, but because most of them are about deals and stuff, we can’t tell you much about it now. One thing really important is we learned so much from the conference and meeting with fellow developers from around the world, and we’re really excited to implement all we learned there in our games and company.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/a12a84b2b61596be55c421485040f40ffd89dc82.jpg
And one last thing, we’re in the really early phase of developing our new games, and we are inviting all of you to participate in the early development by joining our research survey! 
Requirement: NONE. Everyone is welcome to participate.

Fill out the form: https://bit.ly/join-arsanesia-concepttesting

Based on what you fill in, Selected individuals will be asked to fill out another form for the game concept testing and will receive a reward!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/fb8657593323b45b776715d79e879275f014927c.png
That’s it for this development blog! Thank you so much for reading this long blog. See you next time in the next news and update!

notes.title: Welcome 2023~
notes.content:
Hi everyone! Happy 2023!
2022 is when we decided to restart the development of Project UNSEEK, and it has been almost a year since we started redeveloping the game. So many things happened in such a short span; restarting our Discord and Twitter, many monthly playtests (thanks for your participation and feedback!), a lot of new mechanics and characters added, a couple of international events, some local events, and our first Steam event! Thank you so much for all of your support! (Especially to our community!) With your help, we can run this far.

Here are some updates on what we will do in January and February.

Steam Next Fest (February 6th, 2023)
We are working to create our first public demo that will be playable on Steam Next Fest. In this demo, you can play using 3 Humans and 2 Creatures on two maps and play it online with your friends and colleagues for free.

What's in this demo version:

 Play using five characters: Jack, Britanny, Louis, Dr. Plague, and Alien.
 Play on the latest map: Lab! Also Forest.
 Onboarding tutorial on how to start and play the game.
 Cross-play with the Community Playtesting version.


We also plan to do some Livestream on our steam page between the 6th - 13th of February 2022. We will also rebroadcast it if you miss the stream. Please stay tuned for more info about the demo and stream.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1758470/Project_UNSEEK/

Community Playtesting
Our last community playtesting was in November 2022, and we skipped it entirely in December. In 2023 we will do it again until the game is released. In the future, unlike the previous session, we will do it more unsupervised and more open. However, it might still be limited to our discord members or opened to the public on Steam. Because of this, we will implement an onboarding tutorial so the new participant can quickly learn the game without needing the dev to explain it every session. 

This community version will also be compatible to cross-play with the Demo version, so you can play it with everyone without asking them to join the community.
So what's the difference with the demo version? 

 The Playtest version will get early access to our latest updates, including new characters, maps, etc.
 The Playtest server will always be open, unlike the Demo version, which might be closed after the event above ends.

Join Project UNSEEK Community on Discord: https://discord.gg/N2vBaxHhH7

We have a lot of exciting plans for Project UNSEEK in 2023; please stay tuned for future information! See you in the next update!

notes.title: Project UNSEEK October 2022 Development Update
notes.content:
Project UNSEEK October 2022 Development Update

Hello everyone, it’s been a while since we wrote about our development progress.

In October, we developed new characters and implemented significant mechanics for Project UNSEEK. We also have news about the events we participate in and what we plan in the near future.

Let’s get into it!

New Playable Characters
You can now play as Britanny and Alien. In previous builds, you could only play as Jack and Dr. Plague. Let us introduce them all.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/df921a4573f78b5c0ae66599da132cc5d22eccb3.png

Brittany (NEW!)
The only female human character so far. A popular girl in her school loves playing pranks, cruel jokes, and insulting others to show dominance with her gang. Basically, A teen rom-com movie antagonist.

With her special skill: Materialistic, she can help other humans escape the experiment through her instinct to find the most precious item on the maps.

Jack
A popular baseball athlete in his school has a handsome face and an athletic body, but he’s arrogant, hot-headed, and rude. Love to fight and certified bully.

With his special skill: Sprint, he can run faster than any creature (and human) in the experiment ground.

Alien (NEW!)
Found stranded in an undisclosed area. Believed from outer space in our universe. Have high adaptability living on earth because of their ability to mimic humans.

Has special abilities: Quick Mimic, visually transforms into one random human in the experiment ground, and Observer Offspring, summons a youngling on the ground to reveal humans location nearby.

Dr. Plague
Believed to be a doctor from another universe where a deadly outbreak decimated the earth. Mutated so much because of the disease, it is considered almost a human creature by researchers.

Has special abilities: Otherwordly Concoction, brews a strengthening potion and consumes it to move faster, and Mark of the Sunbreak, every time it catches a human, leaves a mark behind, reducing human’s movement speed.

Items and Skills Mechanics
Now every character can utilize skill, as explained above. Also, special for humans can use items scattered around the experiment ground to help them finish their objectives.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/3eca28dabd6a30aa7f59ad6ba3ac4357c23b290a.png
Big Lamp
Big lamp with limited fuel. Your field of view will be larger for a certain duration.

Baseball Bat
Old baseball bat with rotten wood to knock creatures down.

Instruction Manual
Instruction Manual for old computers. Boost some progress on computer hacking.

Ritual Dagger
The bloody ritual dagger is used for otherworldly rituals. Its mystic power has the ability to help escape from Creature's grasp.

Other updates:
Other than the updates above, we’re also making some changes to the game's overall experience

Visual revamp

We’re revamping the overall art style with a new style, combining 2D and 3D assets to create a stylish and functional visual.

New UI/UX
Inspired by mystery movie visuals and old computers, we’re creating a new UI to create more immersive experiences.

Bug Fix
As the game is in development, there are still a lot of bugs found in the build, and we’re trying to fix them on every new version.

Events
Besides development, Project UNSEEk is also attending and featured in various offline and online events.

Level Up Kuala Lumpur

Thanks to support from Asosiasi Game Indonesia, Project UNSEEK can attend and open a booth at Level UP KLM. At the event, we met incredible people from the games industry and received feedback and insight from them.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/4dccfbbc295ec5db3883de39add0cff80d261c64.jpg

Gamescom Asia

Our first time attending an international event independently was a great experience. Even though the event is B2B only, we have so many visitors at our booth, from students, game dev, publisher, and the legendary Shuhei Yoshida of Playstation, that give us much valuable feedback and appreciation.
This event also has events on Steam and Project UNSEEK featured on the event page.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/f681eeb821a5a44147f8665a50b912400e8d4f0b.jpg

Steam Scream Fest

Our first-time event on Steam (Not including the Gamescom Asia one), a Halloween event featuring a lot of horror games Steam has to offer. At the event, we’re doing a Livestream on steam, talking about the development of Project UNSEEK and playing the game with the development team. We’re also doing a playtest session on our discord that we will explain next.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41223563/ea8f548f1dddfdd5de357d899f15ada219e72afd.jpg

Playtest Session October

At the end of October, we’re doing playtest session with our discord server member and other game developers. At the event, we’re introducing all the new features and fixes and getting valuable feedback from all testers participating. This event is also our first time distributing the playtest build via Steam, it’s a great learning experience for using Steam for the first time.


The Future
As the development continues, we plan to add more features and characters to Project UNSEEK. We’re also trying to improve the game based on all feedback we receive.

Monthly Playtest Session

We plan to hold monthly playtest sessions as a regular event. By the end of November, we will have another playtest session with our Discord Member. You can also join the event by joining our Discord Server.


Steam Next Fest 2023

We are committed to participating in the Steam Next Fest Event on February 2023 Please stay tuned for more information because we will have a demo you can play!

That's it for this development blog; thank you for your time reading this long blog and your support so far! See you in the next updates!


Note: Work in progress. The gameplay and visuals shown or described in this blog might change in the final release.
